comparison.objective: Lift a shirt care label clear, pierce only the label with a tagging gun, and fire one fastener; candidate breaks HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Separate a thin flexible label from cloth, precisely place a needle, avoid adjacent material, and actuate a trigger versus coaxial mandrel impact and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Fastener passes through label alone with shirt unpierced and gun safely handled; no retained-coil or released-tang criterion.
comparison.reason: Both involve tool alignment, but this tests selective piercing of layered material, not breaking and recovering a manufactured metal tang.
